verdict.rationale: Self-hosting under an open-source license is a fair question for a scheduling product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only Calendly's hosted SaaS, REST API, embeds, webhooks and MCP server. Nothing shows source code, a container image, an open-source license or a self-hosted deployment option.

support.subject: As a developer, I can self-host the full scheduling engine from source or a container image under an open-source license
